decisions.reason: Changing KiCad 3D-model references from absolute to project-relative paths does not alter BOM contents, part numbers, or design-specification accuracy.
The path-portability decision concerns local 3D-model references and does not change component selection, availability, or cost policies.
Project-relative 3D-model paths do not change the requirement to configure or review manufacturing orders in JLCPCB.
This candidate requires sensor-board fabrication and assembly exports, while the source decision concerns portability of 3D-model references in the integrated KiCad project.
Correcting library paths affects model visibility across machines but does not change the main board's dimensions, orientation, connector placement, or mechanical layout.
The source decision does not change the selected ESP32 module, breakout style, pin access, placement, or pitch.
Portable 3D-model references do not entail any change to enclosure contents, mounting, airflow, assembly, or board-orientation dependencies.
The library-path correction does not modify any ESP32 GPIO assignment or compatibility constraint.
The source decision concerns 3D-model file references and leaves the AXP2101 topology and battery/USB power behavior unchanged.
Making 3D-model paths portable does not change the decoupling capacitor values or their accepted placement.
The source decision has no effect on I2C pull-ups, cable length, bus speed, or series-resistor configuration.
The generic 3D-model path policy does not change the LED board's count, selected LED model, package, part number, or color format.
